setup_speech_to_text_task: setup a SpeechToTextTask by loading the target dictionary and validating train subset names
build_s2t_criterion: build a criterion for the speech to text task with language tag prefix validation
load_s2t_dataset: load a speech to text dataset from TSV files with pre-tokenizer and BPE tokenizer support
build_s2t_model: build a speech to text model with input feature channels from the data configuration
build_s2t_generator: build a sequence generator for speech to text with language token stripping from output
